product.ta-alphatronic-p67.summary: The P67 appears under its own model name in Triumph-Adler’s technical index.
product.ta-alphatronic-p67.history: The manufacturer identifies it in its 1993 documentation catalogue.
product.ta-alphatronic-p67.technical.con: The identifiers help locate the exact documentation. The index gives BA033 / BA034 and shares an entry with Olivetti M290S.
product.ta-alphatronic-p67.technical.ver: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-p67.technical.lim: The full technical documentation, board configuration and ROM remain pending.
